messages:
Taylor (Sales): Kicking off CloudPort POC: need concise prompt inventory + baseline prompts, acceptance criteria, timeline (2w). Who can share SE-first-pass? @Samira? :wave:
Samira (SE): yep, attaching a lightweight prompt inventory and suggested baselines. focusing on 3 flows: intent routing, summary, invoice extraction. short eval plan too.
Alex Su: quick Q — do they care about latency under 150ms p95 per token? or per request? client said 'interactive' so p95 < 500ms per response with 512 tokens cap.
Maria Gómez: Security asks — they want SOC2 + VPC option and an IP/data-retention section in the SOW. I'll drop the checklist.
Raj Patel: pricing check — they'll likely commit to dedicated if we hit < $0.02/1k tokens effective. For POC, propose hosted with 500k token cap on free eval.
Samira (SE): prompt inventory (first pass):
- Intent classification (multi-label)
- Short summary (2-3 bullets)
- Long summary (single paragraph)
- Structured invoice extraction (fields: vendor,date,total,items[])
- Follow-up question generator (clarifying Qs)
Baseline prompts (rudimentary):
```
# Intent classifier
System: You are a model that labels user messages into intents: [billing, support, signup, unknown]. Output JSON.
User: {message}
```
```
# Invoice extractor
System: Extract fields into JSON. If missing, return null.
User: {invoice_text}
```
Samira (SE): Suggested evals: small seed set 50 labeled examples per flow; metrics: accuracy/F1 for classifier, exact-match and field-level F1 for extractor, ROUGE-L for summaries. Pass thresholds: classifier F1 >= 0.85; extractor field-level F1 >= 0.9; summary acceptability >= 0.75 human score.
Taylor (Sales): timeline: week 0: kickoff + data drop; week 1: baseline prompts + 50-sample eval; week 2: optimization + demo. POC ends EOD week 2. Can engineering commit to 2-week turnaround? :calendar:
Alex Su: we can do hosted quick-start for baseline but need sample data by tomorrow to hit week1. Also will test batching config and quantized variant if needed.
Maria Gómez: uploaded security q + SOW blurb to Customer folder. sec-bot will ping legal for IP clause.
sec-bot: Security form submitted to customer portal. Ticket ID: SEC-2025-412.
Raj Patel: ok re pricing — I'll propose a temporary POC rate: $1500 flat + overage at $0.015/1k tokens. If they commit to Dedicated, credit this against first month.
Taylor (Sales): perfect. Action items: @Samira create seed eval sets (50 each) by tomorrow; @Raj draft POC pricing; @Maria confirm SOC2/VPC note in SOW; @Alex prepare hosted infra + sample run. I'll schedule kickoff 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Samira (SE): on it. first eval seeds will be in /customer/cloudport/poc/evals by EOD.
Alex Su: will queue baseline run and post results to thread.
Taylor (Sales): thanks all :thumbsup:
